accounts.name: ops_cash
docs: system-owned `[ops-cash]` PDA before any close reserve is locked.

accounts.name: destination
docs: signature/destination policy before `send_game`.

accounts.name: owner_refund
docs: owner component exists; validated as a payout destination by the handler.

accounts.name: registry
docs: when a new/reopened row appends; active same-owner top-ups need no page.

accounts.name: close_record
docs: Required for `Candidate`; ignored for every other kind.

accounts.name: backer
docs: captured key/series/slot before mutation.

accounts.name: last_registry_page
docs: original page and is written through one alias-safe codec.

accounts.name: governance
docs: The G Vault PDA, signing through a Squads vault-transaction CPI.

accounts.name: governance
docs: The G Vault PDA, signing through a Squads vault-transaction CPI.

accounts.name: oldest_backer
docs: active membership, captured slot, owner binding, and ticket oldest key.

accounts.name: governance_multisig
docs: validated by the handler.

accounts.name: governance
docs: The G Vault PDA, signing through a Squads vault-transaction CPI.

accounts.name: config
docs: handler.

fields.name: guardian_vault
docs: Authoritative guardian key; written by `initialize` and `rotate_guardian`.

types.name: CloseRecord
docs: Everything one closing payout needs: candidate-set progress, the draw,
the captured reserve and its by-source spend ledger.

fields.name: request_rent_funded_s
docs: Sponsor/owner source split of the pending-request rent; equals
`spent.request_rent_s/o` at request time. There is no singular total.

fields.name: eligible_return_remaining
docs: Zero until `observe_request_fulfilled`; then decremented per return.

fields.name: owner_request_rent_refundable_remaining
docs: Zero until observed; then decremented by each owner share paid.

types.name: ConfigTerms
docs: The governance-stageable part of a [`ConfigVersion`]: every field except
the program-assigned `bump`, `version`, `staged_at` and `activated_at`.

types.name: ConfigVersion
docs: One immutable-once-activated rule set. Positions and tickets pin the
version they were created under, so a later version never rewrites them.

fields.name: compound_factors_q18
docs: Compound15 / Compound30 total-return factors (Q18), not per-day rates.

types.name: Funding
docs: Who pays a page's rent. Frozen Borsh order: `Free` 0, `Caller` 1, `LockedClose` 2.

types.name: InitializeArgs
docs: Genesis configuration.  `sponsor` is intentionally repeated in the args
and as a signer account so a fee payer cannot silently become the sponsor.

fields.name: cluster_domain
docs: Immutable cluster domain (devnet and mainnet differ); stored once in
`Pool.cluster_domain` and never writable again.

fields.name: provider_request_fee_lamports
docs: Provider tuple and launch fields written into `ConfigVersion#1`; they
are launch values, so `ConfigVersion::default_v1` leaves them zeroed.

fields.name: locked_remaining_total
docs: O(1) aggregate of close-reserve lamports still locked; never rescanned.

fields.name: unallocated_excess
docs: Anonymous OpsCash credits not yet assigned to a partition.

types.name: PageKind
docs: Which shared page a provisioning or cleanup call addresses. The Borsh
encoding is part of the client ABI: variant order (`Registry` 0,
`Snapshot` 1, `Participant` 2, `Candidate` 3) is frozen.

types.name: PlanKindArg
docs: The three plan discriminants are part of the instruction ABI.  They are
deliberately separate from the host enum so Anchor serializes a stable
on-chain representation without importing host state.

fields.name: cluster_domain
docs: Immutable genesis domain: written once by `initialize`, never again.

fields.name: participant_pages
docs: Current-round participant page capacity; reset at finalize.

fields.name: current_close_id
docs: `Some` exactly while a close is in progress; see [`Pool::closing`].

fields.name: guardian_vault
docs: Genesis guardian vault. `Admission.guardian_vault` is authoritative.
Genesis copy of `Admission.guardian_vault`; `rotate_guardian` (M3) writes both in one instruction.

types.name: PositionOpened
docs: Ingested by the ICP bridge, which compares descriptor fields against
`round_id` (and `close_id`) only; `close_id` is always `None` here.

fields.name: close_id
docs: Always `None`: an opening is never attributed to a close.

types.name: Promotion
docs: Outcome of the close's Series-B promotion draw.

types.name: PromotionApplied
docs: Ingested by the ICP bridge, which compares descriptor fields against
`round_id` and `close_id` only; `close_id` is always `Some` here.

fields.name: close_id
docs: Always `Some`: a promotion belongs to exactly one close.

types.name: RentComponents
docs: Who funded a shared account's rent, in at most two components (DR-13).
The actual payer of the `create_account` CPI is the `OpsCash` PDA; this
records the beneficial funders and where the owner share is refunded.

types.name: ReserveSchedule
docs: Rent and provider prices snapshotted into a `CloseRecord` at close time.

fields.name: client
docs: The registered ORAO client this authority signs requests for.

types.name: SeriesAFunded
docs: Ingested by the ICP bridge, which compares descriptor fields against
`round_id` (and `close_id`) only; `close_id` is always `None` here.

fields.name: close_id
docs: Always `None`: funding is never attributed to a close.

types.name: SpentLedger
docs: Spent ledger by category (candidate page, registry page, B account,
provider fee, pending-request rent) and source (`_s` sponsor, `_o` owner).

fields.name: close_id
docs: `Some` when this ticket allocates a closing payout's toll.

fields.name: a_remainder_total
docs: Discovery accumulator: U256 sum of Series-A remainders, little-endian.
A sum of u128 remainders can exceed u128, so it never narrows.

fields.name: sealed_a_denominator
docs: Fixed U256 denominator frozen at seal, serialized little-endian.

fields.name: senior_bps
docs: Backer-half split pinned from `ConfigVersion` when the ticket is created.
